composition.laptop_visibility: show the back of the laptop toward the viewer

style.shading: simple pixel shading with a limited color palette

scene.environment: minimal workspace with a subtle hacker atmosphere
scene.mood: focused, cool, slightly mysterious, cyberpunk-leaning, nostalgic
scene.background: dark and uncluttered, with a few subtle glowing monitor accents or code-like shapes

details.extras: optional faint neon glow, terminal-style screen light, tiny code fragments, moody lighting
details.avoid: overly complex cyberpunk city, busy background, realistic rendering

requirements.clarity: strong silhouette and readable subject at small sizes
